residual_findings.title: novel-brainstorm / novel-write fall through to _ => 1 in preset_version_for_id; no test guard (preset-version drift surface)
residual_findings.scope: crates/nexus-orchestration/src/auto_chain.rs:1451-1468 (preset_version_for_id fallback); :2127-2174 (sync test array omits new cron preset ids)

Fix: add match arms for novel-brainstorm + novel-write in preset_version_for_id; extend preset_version_mapping_matches_yaml sync test array. Failure mode is silent but cheap to fix now.

residual_findings.title: cron_fires_at_minute re-parses the cron expression per (Work, role) per tick (perf hot path)
residual_findings.note: At 1000 Works × 3 roles/min this is ~30ms/tick of avoidable CPU. Suggested fix: parse once on set_schedule_json write (store normalized form) OR memoise per-Work using a small in-process HashMap<(work_id, role), Schedule> cache. Acceptable for V1.50 scale (60s tick budget absorbs); fix in this fix-wave for low-risk surgical change.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.50 T-A P1 fix-wave: `OnceLock<Mutex<HashMap<(work_id, role), (raw, Schedule)>>>` memoisation cache with content-drift invalidation; pub `invalidate_cron_schedule_cache` called from CLI CAS-write path. Test `cron_fires_at_minute_uses_memoised_schedule` passes (100 calls = 1 parse).
